For example, the new GetPropertyIdentifierLocation only matches PropertyDeclarationSyntax. For a positional record property (whose syntax is a ParameterSyntax), BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull now gets a null location and is silently discarded. The MemberNeedsKey path a few lines earlier does handle ParameterSyntax. Before this change that case crashed.
